answer: Weight lives only as a reef built by judged work: a head’s first layer is signed when one thread reaches its jetty and locks 1 salt. The same operator’s kth head is admitted only after that single thread has re-hardened layers 1..k−1 in order and the jetty locks k more salt, slashed if two layers match. Honest head: one pass, 1 salt. n clones need 1+…+n serial passes and n(n+1)/2 salt on one reef; a fresh reef starts weightless, so cloning buys no voice.
